candidate_reports.remark: Law enforcement reports portions of US 441 in Okeechobee city impassable due to flooding.
Law enforcement reports portions of SR 70 in Okeechobee City impassable due to flooding.
Law enforcement reports flood water entering buildings near the intersection of SW Park St and SW 4th Ave.
The WeatherFlow station at Melbourne Beach Barrier Island Sanctuary measured a peak wind gust of 43MPH/37KT from the east at 11:52 PM. Earlier_ a gust to 41MPH/36KT occurred at 11:27 PM.
Standing water on roads near August St SE & Emerson Dr SE in Palm Bay.
Horizon View Ave is flooded. Water depth is nearly halfway up car tires.
Palm Bay PD reports flooding at Jupiter and White in Palm Bay. Also reports flooding at Garbelmann and Gawain as well as multiple intersections along Emerson.
Photo on social media shows approximately 6-8" of standing water on a road near Emerson Dr NW and Jupiter Blvd NW in Palm Bay.
Melbourne PD has reported a road closure near Sarno Rd & Eau Gallie Blvd due to flooding.
Trained spotter reported flooding near Nebraska St NE & Rome Ave NE. Two vehicles are stalled in the water.
Media reports a road closure at at Helen St & Minton Rd due to flooding.
